description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 2990014849327 SENSOR,ENGINE COOLA: Line 0001 Qty 90 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0034 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
